tradeSays.line: 🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

Farid leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Big Beast. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Big Beast: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
A cart-driver with flour on their sleeves waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
